notes: 0.9B document-parsing vision model (CogViT encoder + GLM-0.5B decoder, glm4 arch); MIT license; OmniDocBench V1.5 94.62 (#1 at release), olmOCR-Bench 75.2.
Served via llama-server --mmproj (ggml-org official Q8_0 weights + Q8_0 mmproj projector, ~1.8GB total); LLAMA_SERVER_BIN pinned to the local build verified for mtmd/mmproj support.
Task prompts are plain strings sent with a page image: 'Text Recognition:', 'Formula Recognition:', 'Table Recognition:'. Information extraction uses user-supplied JSON-schema prompts.
The upstream SDK wraps the model with PP-DocLayoutV3 layout analysis (Apache-2.0); the raw llama-server path serves page-level parsing without that pipeline.
Greedy decode (temperature 0.0) via the glm-ocr profile; ctx 32768 conservative under the 131072 native ceiling.
Selection rationale: reports/Best small PDF parsing model.md (benchmarks: olmOCR-Bench + OmniDocBench v1.6).
Verify size and sha256 locally before flipping provenance_status to verified.
